items.title: io.github.stationdevx:arena-junit 5.4.0 发布, JUnit integration for Arena. Arena is a cross-platform sandboxing framework with built-in profiling workflows. It manages the lifecycle of a set of dependencies (databases, brokers, HTTP services) and components (your applications) as a single sandbox you can open, interact with, and close - giving you repeatable, deterministic, multi-service environments with a fast feedback loop. Arena provides top-level clients for Python, Java, Go, and .NET (the Python client arena-pytest, Java client arena-junit, and .NET client arena-xunit all ship today; a Go client is planned). Component testing is one common use case, but Arena is equally at home as a local development sandbox, a scripted scenario driver, or anywhere else you need a reproducible multi-service environment.

items.title:
com.github.gbenroscience:parser-ng 3.0.4 发布, Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies. 
        ParserNG is the height of interpreted Math parsing in Java. It is the fastest of all interpreted Java math parsers.
        Features the introduction of native logic processing within the engine: the if(cond, trueVal, falseVal) method, the AND operator and the OR operator;
        automatic differentiation to the nth-order, a brand new symbolic differentiation engine, 
        a symbolic integration backed with a resilient numerical integration engine.
        Differential Equations solver is the shiny new feature of ParserNG. It is a highly optimized and robust solver that can handle 
        stiff and non-stiff ODEs, as well as systems of ODEs. 120 tests have been added to the differential equations solver engine
        For library support, customizations or donations, reach me at gbenroscience@gmail.com|+2348165779034

        Fastest Java math evaluator in the world period
        Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies.(e.g. JNI) 
        Version 3.0.4 features GPU bulk evaluation for OpenCL(tested) and CUDA. It also features the SIMDEnginvEvaluator and SIMDCommandTurboEvaluator, both
        of which benefit from CPU Pinning to minimize cache thrashing and other stories. This leads to highly efficient worker-count to output velocity conversion. 
        For library support, customizations or donations, reach me at gbenroscience@gmail.com|+2348165779034
